sources.title: Darren Waller, Carolina Panthers agree to one-year deal | Reports
sources.description: Tight end Darren Waller, a Pro Bowler in 2020 who posted back-to-back 1,000-yard seasons, has agreed to sign with the Carolina Panthers.
